summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for coach OpenAI streaming, session ownership, safety/privacy routing, language constraints (EN/ID only), auth gating, and tab/coach UI smoke. Backend targeted suite passed 15/15. Frontend found a reproducible post-language-reload blank-content bug on desktop.

ui_bugs.component: Tabs content area after profile language change + reload
ui_bugs.issue: After switching profile language to Indonesian and reloading, main tab content becomes blank (white panel) while bottom tab bar remains visible. profile-screen and other screen testIDs are not rendered post-reload.

integration_issues.issue: Language toggle write appears to persist, but reload enters a broken UI state where authenticated tab content fails to mount/render.

action_items: Fix post-reload rendering/state hydration after profile language switch (EN/ID) so tab screens mount consistently.
Add frontend error-state fallback when authenticated screen data/bootstrap fails (current behavior can show blank white content region).
Retest language-switch reload on desktop viewport 1920x800 and mobile 390x844.
Optionally harden coach delete interaction while streaming/busy transitions to avoid intermittent dialog-open race conditions.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py remains a very large monolith (>900 lines) and should be split into focused routers/modules for maintainability and safer regressions.
Coach API guardrails are implemented defensively (allowlisted safe_context, safety-routed local replies, ownership and lock checks) and should be preserved during refactors.
Frontend should include explicit resilient mounted-state/error UX after reload/auth bootstrap to avoid silent blank panes.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST coach users via /api/auth/register during pytest only; no credentials file changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key reproducible UI bug: login as demo -> Profile tab -> tap prof-lang-id -> reload page -> tabs visible but main content blank; profile-screen never appears (reproduced 3 times). Mobile coach stream smoke passed and no horizontal overflow detected at 390x844. Desktop coach flow passed for direct /coach load, consent, history/privacy/delete modal close buttons, and streaming reply. Stopped further selector retries for profile-screen per loop-prevention guidance.
rca of the issue: Likely frontend state/bootstrap race after language persistence + full reload in authenticated tabs. Evidence: no backend/API errors surfaced in console, bottom tabs render but screen containers do not mount with expected testIDs. This points to client-side hydration/navigation state mismatch rather than API availability.
